verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a client/server UI rendering library. Setting up autonomous background automations or agentic schedules is outside what this kind of product does, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. Its reactive effects rerunning on state changes are an in-app rendering mechanism, not user-configurable background automations, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
